Name: Wave Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
[size=3]So This mod is inspired by the theme for the 2020 Summer Modding Contest for the Stardew Valley Discord "Waves".[/size]
[size=3]
Features
~Palm Trees (Be careful, they do not have seeds you can pick up, they can only replicate via spreading, if you break them all, no more Palm Trees)
~Walkable water tiles with little splish-splash noises! (animals can and will walk on it too)[This is the lightest color water in the pictures, connecting the islands]
~A Small Quarry!
~Many Islands to farm on or do what you want! (all the sand is tillable)
~Ocean Fish (Vanilla Only) [Crab pots are hard-coded so they are still default]
~**NEW** Beach Forage!             [Note: With how the game handles foragables the beach forage spawned on the farm will ALWAYS be basic quality. I cannot change it. :( ][/size]

[size=5]-The Path to the Forest is on the East side of the map, below the path to the Bus Stop[/size]

[size=3]Compatibility[/size]
[size=3]Should be compatible with most things, [/size][size=5]including SVE[/size]

The mods that let you swim anywhere will dive into the shallow water instead of walking on it, because of how it reads whether a tile is water is the same thing that lets the animation for water play.

[size=3]Only other things that might be incompatible are if a retexture mod changes the beach colors, sand and water specifically, as there are a few custom tiles. (I can make a version for those if it is brought to my attention)[/size]

[size=3]The ocean fish you can catch on the farm will only be the Vanilla Ocean Fish, extra fish from other mods will not be catch-able on the farm itself.[/size]

[size=4]Known Bugs[/size]
If you exit to menu and load a save, the rotated tiles will (temporarily) un-rotate for the next load, I recommend exiting the game entirely and re-entering if you have to do such a thing. (Tis a framework thing, not much I can do about it) [Fixed

[size=3]Mods I like to always recommend[/size]
[size=3]Upgrade Empty Cabins-[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5253]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5253[/url]
[size=3]For storage or extra houses to sleep in.[/size]
[size=3]Destroyable Bushes - [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304
[/url][size=3]Please use it to free up area that you would like to build upon that is otherwise blocked by bushes.
Waterproof Items - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6460]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6460[/url]
There's a LOT of water, Waterproof your items! (even the shallow water will eat your items)[/size]

[size=3]Installation[/size]
[size=3]Install all the required mods, listed in the requirements section above (and maybe some of the recommended)[/size]
[size=3]Download the zip[/size]
[size=3]Unzip the contents, it will have a Wave Farm Folder in it. [/size]
[size=3]You need to move that folder into your mod folder (which is inside the stardew valley folder).[/size]
[size=4]
<3 Special Thanks to Many People in the Stardew Valley Modding Discord <3
More Specifically
Mouse wrote the lua code that allows me to tie the water sound effect to the shallow water
Esca wrote the entirety of the Ocean Fish replacement for me.
Jonqora who helped me find the data for the beach forage and figure out the ratio's of forage for the map
<3

I Try to fix everything before I publish, But I'm only human and makes mistakes, If you notice any errors or anything PLEASE LET ME KNOW.[/size]
